notes.title: NextSim21 - Announcement
notes.notes:
We are very happy to finally announce that we are part of the NextSim21 event by Aerosoft again this year! With over 15 simulation titles from different developer studios, we will do a videostream in which we talk about the current events in the simulation industry together with Aerosoft.

The stream will be broadcasted for the first time on 26th August 2021 at 3pm CEST in the course of the digital gamescom. In addition to us as developers, the youtubers nordrheintvplay as well as TheNorthernAlex will be taking part as well.

We are happy to be part of the event and hope to delight you with the stream! 

[previewyoutube=Fn7YJyMzyhw;full][/previewyoutube]
